sensors.name: light sensor LLIGHT (light from above, dim inside a tunnel)

control_flow: avoidWalls: if LLIGHT is below 70 %, check the obstacle sensors: a wall on the left means turn left 20°, a wall on the right means turn right 20°, otherwise call driveInTheDark; in bright light it calls driveInTheDark at once.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 %, drive forward at 30 %; otherwise call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: curve left when the line tracker sees black, curve right otherwise.

likely_intent.description: In a dark tunnel, turn right when a wall is close on the left and left when a wall is close on the right, so it gets through a bending tunnel without touching it.

decision_points.condition: the light sensor LLIGHT reads below 70 % (dim light inside a tunnel)

branches.outcome: dim light: it checks the obstacle sensors on its left and right
bright light: it goes on to driveInTheDark

decision_points.condition: first: an obstacle on the left; second: an obstacle on the right

branches.outcome: a wall in front of its left half: it turns left by 20°
no wall on the left, a wall on the right: it turns right by 20°
nothing on either side: it calls driveInTheDark

decision_points.condition: the light sensor LLIGHT reads below 70 % inside driveInTheDark

branches.outcome: dim light: it drives forward at 30 %
